fml.menu.mods.info.description.airline: Connects MineColonies colonies with Create Aeronautics airships. Build airfields (small, medium and large) and anchorages in a colony, and each airfield builds aircraft of the classes that can land there from parts the colony supplies. Pilots fly them on a timetable, carrying warehouse surplus to the colonies that want it. Routes run between air buoys and airfields and are checked for obstacles before use. Tavern visitors arrive by aircraft. Flight requires Sable and Create Aeronautics.
com.airline.building.airfield.desc: A hangar with a landing pad for vertical take-off and landing. Surplus that other colonies want is collected from the warehouse onto its export racks; the pilot loads it onto the aircraft and delivers it on scheduled flights. Incoming cargo goes into the stash, and couriers take it to the warehouse.

message.airline.fuel.put: Added %s fuel to the tank. It now holds %s minutes of flight.
message.airline.fuel.full: The tank is full (%2$s minutes of flight).
commands.airline.flight.no_room: No room on the landing pad: something is in the way at %s %s %s.

commands.airline.flight.no_aircraft: There is no aircraft on that airfield's landing pad.
commands.airline.design.off: Design tools are disabled in this world. To enable them, set designTools = true in this world's serverconfig\airline-server.toml and reopen the world (never in a world you share with other players).

commands.airline.design.captured: Captured %s blocks and wrote them to %s. The seat, barrels, devices, lever table and handling values are still those of the old design: update them to match, then measure the aircraft on the test bench.
commands.airline.design.ended: Modification mark removed. While the aircraft is at home, the airfield restores it to its design.
commands.airline.flight.modifying: That aircraft is under modification and can't fly (/airline design end <colony> removes the mark).
message.airline.yard.modifying: This airfield's aircraft is under modification and can't leave.
commands.airline.flight.no_pilot: There is no pilot at that airfield right now.
commands.airline.flight.no_route: There is no route between the two airfields on the air network.
commands.airline.flight.sent: Flight ordered: %s points, %s blocks. The pilot is walking to the aircraft.
commands.airline.flight.none: No aircraft are loaded in this dimension.
commands.airline.flight.note.not_boarded: Flight cancelled: the pilot didn't reach the seat in time.
commands.airline.flight.note.not_left: The pilot can't get off the landed aircraft. The aircraft stays anchored and waits. Please check on it.
commands.airline.flight.note.cancelled: Flight cancelled: the route was blocked with no alternative. The aircraft is back where it started.
commands.airline.flight.note.no_way_back: The aircraft stays where it landed: there is no route back, or no pilot.
commands.airline.flight.note.blocked: An aircraft found its line blocked by the block at %s %s %s and is going back to the previous point.
commands.airline.flight.note.turning_bac: No other route to the destination: the aircraft is returning to where it started.
commands.airline.flight.note.cancelled_t: Flight cancelled: the line was too high to climb to and there was no other route. The aircraft is back where it started.
commands.airline.flight.note.too_high: An aircraft stopped climbing at y = %s and can't reach its line at y = %s: the air is too thin to hold it up. Its class won't use that line; it takes another route or turns back.
commands.airline.flight.note.waiting: An aircraft is blocked ahead and behind, or another ship is in its way. It holds its altitude and waits.
commands.airline.flight.note.no_pilot_in: An aircraft was in the air for a minute with no one in the pilot's seat. It has been abandoned: anchored where it is and no longer kept loaded. Please check on it.
commands.airline.flight.no_floor_there: The landing pad there has no floor (the airfield isn't built). Flight not ordered.

commands.airline.flight.note.no_floor: The landing pad at %s %s %s has no floor. The aircraft returns to where it started and the flight is cancelled.
commands.airline.flight.note.no_floor_st: The landing pad at %s %s %s has no floor and there is no way back. The aircraft is anchored in the air above it. Please check on it.
commands.airline.flight.status: Aircraft: %s. From %s to %s. Cargo out / back: %s. %s
commands.airline.flight.cancel.too_late: Too late to call off: the aircraft is already heading back, landing, or finishing.
commands.airline.flight.cancel.turning: Flight called off. The aircraft is returning to where it started and will land there.
commands.airline.flight.cancel.before: Flight called off before take-off. Any loaded cargo goes back onto the export racks.
commands.airline.flight.cancel.ended_the: Flight ended on the pad where the aircraft stands (%s %s %s). It won't fly back on its own.
commands.airline.flight.note.calling_off: A flight was called off by command.
commands.airline.flight.note.called_off: Flight called off by command: the aircraft is back where it started.
commands.airline.flight.note.ended_there: A flight was ended by command where the aircraft landed.
commands.airline.flight.note.failed_on_p: Flight cancelled: the aircraft's controller failed on the pad (see the server log). The aircraft stays on its pad and can be used again.
commands.airline.flight.clear.none: No abandoned aircraft is loaded here. Go near it first: abandoned aircraft are not kept loaded.
commands.airline.flight.clear.given: Removed %s abandoned aircraft. The %s items from the hold are in your inventory (anything that didn't fit is at your feet).

commands.airline.flight.table.flying: Timetable: aircraft based at %s. In flight to %s, arriving in %s
commands.airline.flight.note.nobody_carr: No pilot has handled the cargo for two minutes (asleep, stuck in the seat, or gone). The aircraft waits on its pad.
commands.airline.flight.note.pilot_canno: The pilot couldn't walk to the handover spot and handed the cargo over from where it stood. If this keeps happening, check the path between the aircraft and the racks.

com.airline.gui.timetable.aircraft.distr: Out of fuel in the air. Bring it fuel.
